shortDescription: Manage BGP Config for Equinix Metal Project

options.name: asn
options.description: Autonomous System Number for local BGP deployment

options.name: deployment_type
options.description: "local" or "global". Local deployment type is likely to be usable immediately,  "global" will need to be reviewed by Equinix Metal support.

options.name: md5
options.description: Password for BGP session in plaintext (not a checksum)

options.name: project_id
options.description: UUID of the project where BGP Config should be enabled

options.name: use_case
options.description: Description of your BGP use-case for Equinix Metal support
